query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `email_tracking_events` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `prospectId` INT,
  `messageId` VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  `eventType` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `url` TEXT,
  `occurredAt` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `raw` JSON,
  `createdAt` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_ete_prospectId` (`prospectId`),
  INDEX `idx_ete_messageId` (`messageId`(255)),
  INDEX `idx_ete_eventType` (`eventType`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `draft_emails` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `prospectId` INT NOT NULL,
  `subject` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `body` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `agentReasoning` TEXT,
  `status` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `sentAt` DATETIME,
  `resendMessageId` VARCHAR(255),
  `createdAt` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_de_prospectId` (`prospectId`),
  INDEX `idx_de_status` (`status`),
  INDEX `idx_de_resendMessageId` (`resendMessageId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `prospect_activities` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `prospectId` INT NOT NULL,
  `type` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `title` VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
  `description` TEXT,
  `metadata` JSON,
  `createdAt` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_pa_prospectId` (`prospectId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `prospect_research` (
  `id` INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `prospectId` INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `companyOverview` TEXT,
  `robotSpecs` JSON,
  `competitiveContext` TEXT,
  `useCases` JSON,
  `whyStageGate` TEXT,
  `showIntel` TEXT,
  `decisionMakers` JSON,
  `apolloOrgId` VARCHAR(100),
  `researchStatus` VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `researchError` TEXT,
  `researchedAt` DATETIME,
  `createdAt` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_pr_prospectId` (`prospectId`)
);
